# Pixpa

> Pixpa is a no-code portfolio and ecommerce website builder designed for creative professionals including photographers, artists, models, and designers.

Pixpa provides an integrated platform combining portfolio galleries, online stores, and blogging capabilities. The platform offers 10+ professionally designed templates tailored to specific creative industries and use cases, enabling users to build responsive, conversion-focused websites without coding.

## Core Platform

- [Create Your Awesome Portfolio Website - Pixpa](https://www.pixpa.com): Pixpa homepage: no-code portfolio builder for creatives with store, blog & galleries
- [Login to Your Pixpa Account](https://studio.pixpa.com): Pixpa Studio login portal for account access and authentication
- [Pixpa Status](https://status.pixpa.com): Service status page tracking uptime and health of Pixpa Studio and platform
